_about: The Applied Changes Register (Core L-531 (6); Companion Part 124): every change applied under the standing adoption, with what it is for, what exercises it, and what would show that it only makes the protocol more elaborate. A change that nothing exercises is flagged for review, and is kept, revised or withdrawn by a later recorded change, never by a silent edit. Checked by python3 tools/applied.py --check, in CI.
